connector.name: Socraticode
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for local codebase indexing, semantic search, and code dependency graphs.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package socraticode. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the giancarloerra account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: EMBEDDING_PROVIDER
env.description: Embedding provider to use: ollama (default), openai, or google

env.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
env.description: API key for OpenAI embeddings (required only when EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=openai)

env.name: GOOGLE_API_KEY
env.description: API key for Google embeddings (required only when EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=google)

env.name: OLLAMA_URL
env.description: URL of the Ollama server (default: auto-detected; Docker-managed or http://localhost:11434)

env.name: EMBEDDING_MODEL
env.description: Embedding model name (defaults per provider: nomic-embed-text for ollama, text-embedding-3-small for openai, gemini-embedding-001 for google)

env.name: QDRANT_MODE
env.description: Qdrant mode: managed (default, Docker-managed) or external (user-provided instance)

env.name: QDRANT_URL
env.description: Full URL for remote/cloud Qdrant (e.g. https://xyz.cloud.qdrant.io:6333). Only needed when QDRANT_MODE=external

env.name: QDRANT_API_KEY
env.description: API key for remote Qdrant instance. Only needed when QDRANT_MODE=external
